title: Leading the Future AI Super PAC Raises Zero New Donations in Third Quarter
summary:
A political group's only revenue during the July through September period was $200,000 in bank interest, a Federal Election Commission filing reveals. Leading the Future, an AI super PAC, took in no outside contributions during that window, meaning the organization added no fresh money from donors to its capital reserves.

This funding result follows reporting this month that a promised $25 million donation from Greg Brockman never materialized. The group's total growth of $200,000 for the period came exclusively from interest earned on cash already held in its bank account.
